H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); rline=9; cline=8
out=[[1]*W for _ in range(H)]
# Keep all 7s lying on either ray/cut at their original positions
for r in range(H):
    for c in range(W):
        if grid[r][c]==7 and (r==rline or c==cline): out[r][c]=7
# Translate off-axis 7s in each quadrant to the matching corner
for name, pred, top, left in [
    ('UL', lambda r,c:r<rline and c<cline, True, True),
    ('UR', lambda r,c:r<rline and c>cline, True, False),
    ('LL', lambda r,c:r>rline and c<cline, False, True),
    ('LR', lambda r,c:r>rline and c>cline, False, False),
]:
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if grid[r][c]==7 and pred(r,c)]
    if not cells: continue
    minr=min(r for r,c in cells); maxr=max(r for r,c in cells); minc=min(c for r,c in cells); maxc=max(c for r,c in cells)
    dr=(-minr if top else H-1-maxr)
    dc=(-minc if left else W-1-maxc)
    print(name,'src bbox', (minr,maxr,minc,maxc),'cells',cells,'shift',(dr,dc))
    for r,c in cells: out[r+dr][c+dc]=7
# Paint rays: row from left marker to rightmost 7 on row; column from top marker to bottommost 7 in col.
row7=[c for c in range(W) if grid[rline][c]==7]
col7=[r for r in range(H) if grid[r][cline]==7]
print('row7',row7,'col7',col7)

    if out[rline][c]!=7: out[rline][c]=2
for r in range(max(col7)+1):
    if out[r][cline]!=7: out[r][cline]=2
print('output:')
for row in out: print(' '.join(map(str,row)))
print('7 coords')
for r,row in enumerate(out):
    coords=[c for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==7]
    if coords: print(r,coords)
